# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stages of the escalation ladder
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_update_stage = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 6 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_old = cwgg_stufe }
		# going up needs the numbers to be clearly worse, going down clearly better
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_k = cwgg_klima }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_i = cwgg_krise_int }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_k = 5 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_i = -5 }
		
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > 39 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > 9 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > -21 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 49 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k < -45 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 74 } } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 89 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_k < -60 } } AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr > 2 } } AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 2 } } check_variable = { cwgg_countdown > 0 } } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 5 } }
	# troops massed at the border: one side means crisis, both sides confrontation
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 1 } } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_up = cwgg_t_s }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_k = cwgg_klima }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_i = cwgg_krise_int }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_k = -5 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_i = 5 }
		
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > 39 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > 9 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k > -21 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 49 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_k < -45 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 74 } } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_i > 89 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_k < -60 } } AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr > 2 } } AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 2 } } check_variable = { cwgg_countdown > 0 } } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 5 } }
	# troops massed at the border: one side means crisis, both sides confrontation
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 1 } } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_s < 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_s = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_down = cwgg_t_s }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_up > cwgg_stufe } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_stufe = cwgg_t_up } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_down < cwgg_stufe } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_stufe = cwgg_t_down } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > cwgg_t_old } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 38 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.5 days = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe < cwgg_t_old } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 39 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_set_stage_modifiers = yes
}

		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_ten = 0.2 }
	}

		if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_stab = -0.03 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_ws = 0.06 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_cg = 0.01 } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_ten = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 4 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_stab = -0.06 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_ws = 0.1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_cg = 0.02 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_fac = 0.0 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_stab = -0.05 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_ws = 0.1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_cg = 0.02 } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_ten = 1.0 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 5 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_stab = -0.08 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_ws = 0.15 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_cg = 0.02 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_fac = -0.05 } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { GER.cwgg_mob_brd = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_dm_mob = 0.0 } } }

# Monthly world tension from the ladder (Imperia).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_stage_tension = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_ten = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = cwgg_t_ten }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 5 } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension < 70 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 70 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- monthly tick (GER scope)
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_tick = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_initialized } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_setup = yes }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_months = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_months > 11 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_months = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_year = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = DDR } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 6 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 0 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		# events and focuses written for the old 'rapprochement' meter still move the climate
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwger_ostpolitik }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_ost_last }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 2 }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = cwgg_t } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_initiative = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_bahr days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 40 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_bahr } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_sv days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 41 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_sv } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_vogel days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 42 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_vogel } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_koko days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 43 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_koko } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_kirche days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 44 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_kirche } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			100 = { }
			1 = {
				modifier = { add = 1 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 30 } }
				modifier = { add = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } }
				modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 70 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_strained_draht days = 365 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 45 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strained_draht } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_climate = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_negotiation_tick = yes
		# East Berlin's AI only acts for an AI GDR; a human GDR uses its decisions
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = yes } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ddr_ai = yes }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_bonn_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_border_watch = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_crisis_clock = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_crisis_roll = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_war_watch = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_update_stage = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_stage_tension = yes
		# the old meter now follows the climate
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwger_ostpolitik = cwgg_klima } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_ostpolitik = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { divide_variable = { cwger_ostpolitik = 2 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_ost_last = cwger_ostpolitik } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 6 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_war_watch = yes }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_initiative = {
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_init_bonus } random_list = { 50 = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = 1 } } } 50 = { } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = 1 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_init_brd min = 0 max = 6 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 70 } } } random_list = { 50 = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr = 1 } } } 50 = { } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_init_ddr min = 0 max = 6 } }
}

# Climate drifts towards a base set by treaties, world tension, the SED leader, Moscow,
# the Deutschlandpolitik balance, the government in Bonn and the open channels.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_climate = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_1 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_2 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_3 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_4 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_5 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_6 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_7 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_8 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_9 = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 4 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = cwgg_t }
	}
	if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } } date > 1979.12.31 date < 1983.1.1 } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } } date > 1982.12.31 } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 20 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_moscow_coup_succeeded } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -25 } }
	else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_the_sinatra_doctrine } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_new_thinking has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_glasnost_first } } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_the_brezhnev_doctrine } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 17 } is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 17 } } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_roster_greens always = no } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_double_track } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_zero_option } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_policy_strength } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_policy_rapprochement } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = 5 } }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_b = cwgg_basis_bonus }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwgg_t_b min = -100 max = 100 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_basis = cwgg_t_b } }
	# drift 5 % towards the base, minus a share of the escalation pressure
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_basis }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_klima }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 0.05 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = cwgg_druck }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = 0.03 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_t2 }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = cwgg_t } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { cwgg_druck = 0.9 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
}

# Monthly: massed troops raise escalation pressure and Cold War world tension, cost climate and push the
# ladder; the other side is told when the build-up grows.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_border_watch = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 6 } } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_old_brd = cwgg_aufm_brd_m }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_old_ddr = cwgg_aufm_ddr_m }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_border_count = yes
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd_m = cwgg_aufm_brd } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr_m = cwgg_aufm_ddr } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd = 1 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd = 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 6 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -2 } } if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.25 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 10 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -4 } } if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr = 1 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr = 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 6 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -2 } } if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.25 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 10 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -4 } } if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > cwgg_t_old_brd } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 46 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.241 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > cwgg_t_old_ddr } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 47 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.240 days = 1 } }
	}
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	}
}

	add_political_power = -25
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh = 9 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 56 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_negotiation_tick = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 3 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh = 0 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 57 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe < 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 12 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_verh < 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = cwgg_klima }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = 10 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_t2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = cwgg_hebel_devisen }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t2 = 2 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_t2 }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_policy_rapprochement } multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 1.25 } }
			if = { limit = { DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } check_variable = { cwgg_verh > 2 } } multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 0.5 } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwgg_t min = 2 max = 30 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog = cwgg_t } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog > 99 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog = 100 } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.50 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- East Berlin's moves between crises
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ddr_ai = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr > 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_ddr_ai_cd } }
		random_list = {
			60 = { }
			40 = {
				hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr = -2 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_ddr_ai_cd days = 45 value = 1 }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { add = 15 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency > 50 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_zwang > 2 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_zwang = 1 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_dhebel_zwang min = 0 max = 3 } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -6 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
						DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency = -3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_hard_currency min = 0 max = 100 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = 1 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_exit_pressure min = 0 max = 100 } } }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.121 days = 1 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.2 check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_2 = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_transit = 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -5 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 12 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_berlin_access = -5 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_berlin_access min = 0 max = 100 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 16 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
					}
					15 = {
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration = 4 } }
						hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_stasi_penetration min = 0 max = 100 } }
						if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 40 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 67 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_3 = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_recognition > 79 } } }
						DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_recognition = 4 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_recognition min = 0 max = 100 } } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 17 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
						if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_hebel_recht > 1 } }
							random_list = { 70 = { } 30 = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 5 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes } }
						}
					}
					8 = {
						modifier = { add = 15 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure > 50 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_grenze > 2 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0.2 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_grenze = 1 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_dhebel_grenze min = 0 max = 3 } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 8 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
						DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_exit_pressure = -3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_exit_pressure min = 0 max = 100 } } }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.122 days = 1 }
					}
					0 = {
						modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency > 55 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = cwgg_credit_asked }
						set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_credit_asked days = 720 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.60 days = 2 }
					}
					5 = {
						modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } } }
						modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } } date > 1982.12.31 }
						modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
						modifier = { add = 10 check_variable = { cwgg_klima > 0 } }
						hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = 6 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
						if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_grenze > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_grenze = -1 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_dhebel_grenze min = 0 max = 3 } } }
						if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_zwang > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_zwang = -1 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_dhebel_zwang min = 0 max = 3 } } }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.123 days = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_bonn_ai = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { }
			50 = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_1 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_1 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_2 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_2 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_3 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_3 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_4 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_4 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_5 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_5 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_6 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_6 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_7 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_7 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_8 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_8 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_treaty_9 = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_treaty_9 = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 0 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_open_sv = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_open_sv = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 0 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_open_bahr = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_open_bahr = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 0 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_open_draht = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_open_draht = yes }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_freikauf = yes } random_list = { 70 = { } 30 = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_act_freikauf = yes } } }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_swing = yes check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } random_list = { 80 = { } 20 = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_act_swing = yes } } }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_credit = yes } random_list = { 80 = { } 20 = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_act_credit = yes } } }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_transit = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_act_transit = yes }

}

hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 77 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_open_draht = {
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -1 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 78 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_close_draht = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 79 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- crises
# Starts a crisis of type temp cwgg_t_typ unless one is running.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } country_exists = DDR NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = cwgg_t_typ } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_runde = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_monat = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 1 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_ddr_wahl = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_h = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_a = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_special_used = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_crises_total = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 40 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 4 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.101 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 35 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.102 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 45 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.103 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 4 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 50 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.104 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 5 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 30 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.105 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 6 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 45 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 4 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.106 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 7 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 55 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 2 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.107 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 8 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 30 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.108 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 9 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 25 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 4 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.109 days = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 10 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 70 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_max = 3 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.110 days = 1 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 10 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ask_east_berlin = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_update_stage = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
	}
}

# A human East Berlin chooses its course for the coming round by event.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ask_east_berlin = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { is_ai = no } }
		DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.200 days = 1 } }
	}
}

# Monthly: a round is resolved every six months; a countdown advances every month.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_crisis_clock = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_countdown > 0 } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_countdown_step = yes
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_krise_monat = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_monat > 5 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_monat = 0 } }
				COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_round = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Monthly chance of a new crisis: 1 % plus more for a bad climate and high pressure.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_crisis_roll = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_crisis_cd } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
		random_list = {
			1000 = { }
			18 = {
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_klima < -10 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_klima < -25 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_klima < -40 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_klima < -60 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_druck > 20 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_druck > 45 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 has_country_flag = cwgg_escape_helpers }
				modifier = { add = 25 OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_brd > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_aufm_ddr > 1 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwgg_klima > 30 } }
				COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_pick_crisis = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# a frozen crisis flares up again
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_relapse_typ > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_relapse } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = cwgg_relapse_typ }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_relapse_typ = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 80 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	# crises with fixed causes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_double_track NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_missiles_done } }
		set_country_flag = cwgg_missiles_done
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 6 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 79 } date > 1975.1.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_manoeuvre_cd } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_manoeuvre_cd days = 3650 value = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 7 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 0 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_embassy_done } }
		set_country_flag = cwgg_embassy_done
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 4 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage = 9 } check_variable = { cwddr_crisis > 74 } } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_uprising_done } }
		set_country_flag = cwgg_uprising_done
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 10 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_pick_crisis = {
	random_list = {
		20 = { modifier = { factor = 0.15 check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_2 = 1 } } modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_transit > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 1 } }
		20 = { modifier = { factor = 1.5 check_variable = { cwgg_dhebel_grenze > 2 } } modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = cwgg_escape_helpers } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 2 } }
		10 = { modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 50 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 3 } }
		8 = { modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_3 = 1 } } modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_hebel_recht < 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 5 } }
		10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 date < 1976.1.1 } modifier = { factor = 0 date > 1989.12.31 } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 8 } }
		8 = { modifier = { factor = 0 date > 1989.12.31 } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_typ = 9 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_start_crisis = yes
}

# One round of a crisis (every six months). Bonn's course is cwgg_haltung, East Berlin's is chosen now
# (by its AI, or by the human player through event COLDWAR_GGR.200).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_round = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ > 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_countdown = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_bonn_stance_ai = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = cwgg_haltung }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_deescalate = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -1 } } } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_firm = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -1 } } add_political_power = -10 } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_pressure = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -2 } } } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_allies = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -1 } } } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_secret = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -2 } } } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } } if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_mobilise = yes } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -3 } } } else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ddr_answer = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -30 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 38 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 38 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -38 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -30 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -22 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 45 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 45 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 22 } }
		# the right answer for this kind of crisis
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 6 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 8 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 9 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 10 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -10 } }
		# counter-pressure is only as strong as the lever behind it
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_handel } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_medien } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_recht } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_devisen } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_recht } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_allianz } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 7 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_allianz } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 8 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_medien } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 9 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_recht } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 10 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = cwgg_hebel_medien } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_lev = 0 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_lev > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -5 } }
		}
		# the alliance lever adds weight when the Allies are called
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_hebel_allianz > 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_superpower days = 365 value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 3 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 81 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		}
		# the secret channel: halved through a strained line, and the Stasi may be listening
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_sv = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_vogel = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_koko = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_kirche = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_good = 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 0.5 } }
			random_list = {
				90 = { }
				4 = {
					modifier = { add = 4 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 40 } }
					modifier = { add = 6 check_variable = { cwger_stasi_penetration > 65 } }
					modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_counterintel > 60 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = 15 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 82 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
				}
			}
		}
		# Moscow's guarantee hardens East Berlin's escalation
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = DDR.cwddr_moscow_backing }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 50 }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 7 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = cwgg_t }
		}
		# deterrence: readiness and exercises blunt escalation
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 1 } has_country_flag = cwgg_manoeuvre } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_d_int = -8 } }
		# an AI East Berlin mobilises when it escalates hard with Soviet backing, or when Bonn mobilises against Moscow
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = yes } OR = { AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_krise_int > 59 } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 59 } } } AND = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 } } } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr < 3 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 14 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 7 } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd < 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd = 1 } } }
		# apply
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = cwgg_d_int } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_krise_int min = 0 max = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_d_int > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_d_int }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 2 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = cwgg_t } }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = 2.5 }
			hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { cwgg_klima = cwgg_t } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_d_int < 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = cwgg_d_int }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwgg_t = -10 }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = cwgg_t } }
		}
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_h = cwgg_h } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_a = cwgg_a } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_dint = cwgg_d_int } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_krise_runde = 1 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 900 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = cwgg_a }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		# counter-offers can be taken up when Bonn was talking anyway
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 } OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_h = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_h = 6 } } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.20 days = 1 }
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_update_stage = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_int < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_settle_crisis = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_int > 99 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.11 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_runde > cwgg_krise_max } }
			# exhausted: below 50 the sides settle, above it the crisis freezes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_int < 50 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_settle_crisis = yes }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 3 } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_end_crisis = yes }
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ask_east_berlin = yes
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_quiet } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
	}
}

# Who gave way decides the outcome of a settled crisis.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_settle_crisis = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_last_a = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_last_h = 2 } } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_last_h = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_last_a = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_last_a = 2 } } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 2 } }
	else = { set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 7 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_end_crisis = yes
}

# East Berlin's answer: the human player's choice, or the AI weighted by the SED leader,
# money, Moscow and the balance of force.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_ddr_answer = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { is_ai = no } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_ddr_wahl > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = cwgg_ddr_wahl } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_a > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 } }
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 40 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 2 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control < 40 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 1 }
			}
			30 = {
				modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 2 }
			}
			20 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr < 1 } }
				modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 69 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 40 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.6 check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 1 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } }
				modifier = { factor = 1.3 COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_hardline_moscow = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 3 }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr < 1 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { country_exists = SOV } }
				modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 69 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 40 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { cwgg_last_h = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 4 }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr < 1 } }
				modifier = { factor = 2 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 2 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 1 } } date > 1980.12.31 }
				modifier = { factor = 2 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_a = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_ddr_wahl = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_a > 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr = -1 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_init_ddr min = 0 max = 6 } }
}

# Bonn as AI picks a stance in character with the government.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_bonn_stance_ai = {
	random_list = {
		10 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 1 } } }
		25 = { modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_deescalate = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 2 } } }
		25 = { modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_firm = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 3 } } }
		10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_pressure = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 4 } } }
		15 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_allies = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 5 } } }
		25 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_can_stance_secret = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 6 } } }
	}
}

# Ends the crisis with outcome temp cwgg_t_out: 1 Bonn has its way, 2 East Berlin has its way, 3 frozen,
# 4 Bonn gives way at the brink, 5 East Berlin gives way at the brink, 6 Moscow reins East Berlin in, 7 compromise.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_end_crisis = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_out = cwgg_t_out } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_last_typ = cwgg_krise_typ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 6 } } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_crises_won = 1 } }
		add_stability = 0.02
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = -3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_recognition = -2 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_recognition min = 0 max = 100 } } add_stability = -0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 83 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 4 } } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_crises_lost = 1 } }
		add_stability = -0.02
		DDR = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_sed_control = 3 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_sed_control min = 0 max = 100 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_recognition = 4 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_recognition min = 0 max = 100 } } add_stability = 0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 84 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 7 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = 5 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 85 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 3 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -5 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_druck = 10 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_druck min = 0 max = 100 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 86 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		random_list = { 50 = { } 50 = { set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_relapse days = 180 value = 1 } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_relapse_typ = cwgg_krise_typ } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -10 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 4 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = 10 } }
hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_countdown = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = 1 } }
	set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_crisis_cd days = 365 value = 1 }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.10 days = 1 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.201 days = 1 } } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_update_stage = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

# Choose a stance from the window (temp cwgg_t_h).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_set_stance = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_haltung = cwgg_t_h } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_special_used = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_krise_int min = 0 max = 100 } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.001 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = -25 } } }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_tension_up_1
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 28 }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_krise_int min = 0 max = 100 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_special_8 = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_special_used = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_krise_int min = 0 max = 100 } }
	hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = -15 } } }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_cwddr_opposition_up_3
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwddr_opposition = 3 } } } hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwddr_opposition min = 0 max = 100 } } } } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 35 }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_krise_int min = 0 max = 100 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the brink and war
# Countdown after 'Show resolve' at the peak of a crisis: three monthly steps, driven by the monthly tick.
# A human East Berlin decides itself (event COLDWAR_GGR.210); an AI East Berlin may blink.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_countdown_step = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_countdown > 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ > 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_countdown = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = yes } }
			random_list = {
				70 = {
					modifier = { factor = 1.3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 69 } } }
					modifier = { factor = 1.5 COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_hardline_moscow = yes }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } }
					modifier = { factor = 1.2 check_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr > 2 } }
				}
				30 = {
					modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 50 } } }
					modifier = { factor = 1.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 0 } } date > 1980.12.31 }
					modifier = { factor = 3 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
					hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_countdown = 0 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_east_blinked days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.14 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_countdown > 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.15 days = 1 }
			if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.210 days = 1 } } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_east_blinked } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_final_resolution = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
	}
}

# The countdown has run out and nobody gave way. Only a human may order the attack on West Berlin:
# Bonn's signed strike order, a human East Berlin (event COLDWAR_GGR.211) or, for an AI East Berlin,
# a human Soviet Union (event COLDWAR_GGR.212). Otherwise Moscow always reins East Berlin in.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_final_resolution = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_strike_ordered }
		clr_country_flag = cwgg_strike_ordered
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_path = 1 }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_war_start = yes
	}
	else_if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } }
		DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.211 days = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = no } }
		SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.212 days = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_out = 6 }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_end_crisis = yes
	}
}

# War: temp cwgg_t_path 1 Bonn strikes first, 2 East Berlin attacks, 3 brotherly help for an uprising, 4 false alarm.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_war_start = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 6 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_war_path = cwgg_t_path } }
	set_country_flag = cwgg_war_active
	set_global_flag = cwgg_german_war
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_countdown = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_krise_int = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_klima = -100 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd = 3 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 100 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 87 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_t_path = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_t_path = 3 } } }
		# an AI GDR without Moscow's guarantee leaves the Warsaw Pact faction; a human GDR decides that itself
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = yes is_in_faction = yes check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 40 } } }
			DDR = { leave_faction = yes }
		}
		declare_war_on = { target = DDR type = annex_everything }
		# no automatic call to the alliance: NATO governments decide for themselves
	}
	else = {
		DDR = { declare_war_on = { target = GER type = take_state_focus generator = { 1251 } } }
		# a Soviet Union that ordered the attack, or an AI one that still guarantees the GDR, joins; a human one otherwise decides itself
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { NOT = { has_war_with = GER } }
				OR = { has_global_flag = cwgg_sov_ordered_attack AND = { SOV = { is_ai = yes } DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing > 39 } } } } }
			SOV = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = DDR enemy = GER hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.230 days = 1 } } }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.30 days = 1 }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.31 days = 45 }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_set_stage_modifiers = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

# Watches a running crisis on the brink (false alarm, only if one side is AI) and a running war.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_war_watch = {
	# path D: a false alarm while both armies are on the highest alert and no line is open
	if = { limit = {
			check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 7 }
			check_variable = { cwgg_mob_brd > 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_mob_ddr > 2 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_war_active } NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_false_alarm_cd }
		}
		random_list = {
			82 = { }
			18 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0.25 check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_draht = 1 } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwgg_kanal_bahr = 1 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_false_alarm_cd days = 180 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.21 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_war_active }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = DDR } }
			clr_country_flag = cwgg_war_active
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.40 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { DDR = { has_capitulated = yes } has_war_with = DDR }
			clr_country_flag = cwgg_war_active
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.40 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_capitulated = yes has_war_with = DDR }
			clr_country_flag = cwgg_war_active
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.41 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = DDR } }
			clr_country_flag = cwgg_war_active
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.42 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Monthly, GER scope, after the terror tick.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_tick = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cwsec_initialized } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_setup = yes }
	# US forces count only while US divisions are actually stationed on West German soil
	clr_country_flag = cwsec_us_present
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA any_owned_state = { USA = { divisions_in_state = { state = PREV size > 0 } } } }
		set_country_flag = cwsec_us_present
	}
	# a new generation brings new faces
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_gen_cards = cwger_raf_gen } } check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen < 4 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_gen_cards = cwger_raf_gen } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = 10 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort = 10 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w3_st = 0 } }

hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w5_st = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort = 10 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w6_st = 0 } }
hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_log = 24 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_log = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen > 3 } }

if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 4 } } }

	}

	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = 0.5 }

	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwsec_cd_raster } add_to_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t = cwger_raf_milieu }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwsec_t = 15 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = cwsec_t }
	# each generation learned from the last one's arrests: conspiracy, no phone calls, no fingerprints
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwger_raf_gen = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = -2.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = cwgg_raf_in_ddr NOT = { has_global_flag = cwgg_raf_in_ddr_found } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_gain = -1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t = modifier@terror_threat_detection_modifier }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwsec_t = 6 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwsec_t min = 0 max = 2 }
