# Arrests from the existing terror model take the best-traced card.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_arrest_best = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = -1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w1_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w1_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w2_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w3_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w3_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w3_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w4_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w4_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w4_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w5_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w5_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w6_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w6_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_t_best > -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w1_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 2 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w3_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w3_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w3_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 3 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w4_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w4_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w4_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 4 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w5_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w5_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 5 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w6_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w6_st = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 6 } } }
	}
}

# Raises the trace of the best-traced card by temp cwsec_t.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_boost_best = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = -1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w1_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w1_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w2_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w3_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w3_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w3_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w4_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w4_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w4_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w5_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w5_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w6_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort > cwsec_t_best } } set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_best = cwsec_w6_ort } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_t_best > -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w1_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w1_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w2_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w3_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w3_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w3_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w3_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w4_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w4_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w4_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w4_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w5_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w5_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w5_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_w6_st < 2 } check_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort = cwsec_t_best } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w6_ort = cwsec_t } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w6_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	}
}

# A member leaves the group; after 1979 the Stasi may take them in.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_dropout = {
	random_list = {
		10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w1_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 4 } } } 10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w2_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 4 } } } 10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w3_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w3_st = 4 } } } 10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w4_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w4_st = 4 } } } 10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w5_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w5_st = 4 } } } 10 = { modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { cwsec_w6_st < 2 } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w6_st = 4 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { date > 1979.12.31 country_exists = DDR NOT = { has_global_flag = cwgg_raf_in_ddr } }
		random_list = { 40 = { } 60 = { set_global_flag = cwgg_raf_in_ddr } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_access_1 = {
	set_country_flag = { flag = cwsec_access_cd days = 45 value = 1 }
	add_political_power = -35
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 1 } }
	random_list = {
		30 = {
			modifier = { add = 8 check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort > 74 } }
			modifier = { add = 10 check_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort > 89 } }
			modifier = { add = 6 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 0 } }
			modifier = { add = 6 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 1 } }
			modifier = { add = 5 check_variable = { cwger_bka_level > 1 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 2 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners = 1 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -3 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_cadre min = 0 max = 120 } }
			add_stability = 0.01
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.11 days = 1 }
		}
		45 = {
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = -35 } }
			hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w1_ort min = 0 max = 100 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.12 days = 1 }
		}
		15 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { cwger_gsg9_tier > 1 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.14 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes
}

# Hostage deadline: one scheduled event at the deadline (no polling). Extensions bought by the crisis staff are
# stored in cwsec_ult_ext and re-schedule the deadline in steps of five and three days when it arrives.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_ultimatum_deadline = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_ultimatum }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext > 4 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext = -5 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.1 days = 5 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext > 0 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext = 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.1 days = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_hostage_ultimatum
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_safehouse_raided
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GER.56 days = 1 }
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes
	}
}

# Extends the deadline by temp cwsec_t_ext days (3 or 5).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_extend_deadline = {
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext = cwsec_t_ext } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_ult_end = cwsec_t_ext } }
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_start_ultimatum = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_ult_end = global.num_days } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_ult_end = 21 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_ult_ext = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_stalls = 0 } }
	set_country_flag = cwsec_open
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_tab = 4 } }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GSEC.1 days = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwsec_t_log = 25 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_log = yes
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes
}

# Protection details: toggle for target temp cwsec_t_c.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_protect_justice = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_justice = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_prot_justice = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_used = -1 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_prot_justice = 1 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_used = 1 } } add_political_power = -10 }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes
}

# After a foiled attack the commando turns to whatever is not protected.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_shift_targets = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_justice = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_justice = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_justice min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_business = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_business = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_business min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_usforces = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_usforces = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_usforces min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_politics = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_politics = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_politics min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_infra = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_infra = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_infra min = 0 max = 100 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_prot_embassy = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_plan_embassy = 15 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_plan_embassy min = 0 max = 100 } } }
}

# A raid that ends in a shootout (card temp: cwsec_last_card).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_shootout = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -2 } } }
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w1_st = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w1_ort = -40 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w1_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 2 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -2 } } }
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w2_st = 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwsec_w2_ort = -40 } } hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwsec_w2_ort min = 0 max = 100 } } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 3 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w3_st = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -2 } } }

		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 4 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w4_st = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -2 } } }

		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwsec_last_card = 5 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwsec_w5_st = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = -2 } } }

# ======================================================================== unity through détente
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_setup = {
	set_country_flag = cwgg_u_initialized
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_detente_m = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_m = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_fail = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_veto = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_2 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_3 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 0 } }
}

# Monthly, GER scope, after the inner-German tick.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_tick = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_u_initialized } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_setup = yes }
	# months of unbroken détente
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_klima > 59 } check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_detente_m = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_detente_m = 0 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_detente_m = -1 } } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_detente_m min = 0 max = 120 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase > 0 } OR = { NOT = { country_exists = DDR } has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved has_war_with = DDR } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 0 } }
	}
	# negotiations: a crisis pauses them, a confrontation ends them
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_stufe > 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 88 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_collapse = yes
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_stufe < 3 } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_m = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_m > 2 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_resolve_round = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_propose = {
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_init_brd = -3 } }
	add_political_power = -100
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 89 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.1 days = 1 } } }
	else = {
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 20 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 2 } } }
				modifier = { add = 30 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_hard_currency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_moscow_backing < 40 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 70 } } }
				modifier = { factor = 0.5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 0 } } }
				COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_start = yes
			}
			40 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.3 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_start = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 2 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_m = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_fail = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_veto = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_2 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_3 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 0 } }
	clr_country_flag = cwgg_u_rat_brd
	clr_country_flag = cwgg_u_rat_ddr
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.4 days = 1 }
	if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.31 days = 2 } } }
	every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDIP.240 days = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 90 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_resolve_round = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_m = 0 } }
	# an AI Bonn takes the Western line and moves to the compromise after two failed rounds
	if = { limit = { is_ai = yes check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_2 > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_3 > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = yes } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } }
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 50 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_1 = 1 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 1 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 55 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_1 = 2 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 2 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 70 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 50 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 20 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 70 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_1 = 3 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } }
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }

				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_2 = 1 } }

			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 55 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }

				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_4 = 1 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 1 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 55 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_4 = 2 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 2 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 70 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 50 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 20 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 70 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_4 = 3 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } }
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 5 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 50 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_5 = 1 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 1 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 25 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 55 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 40 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_west_dependency > 60 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 2 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_5 = 2 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 2 } }
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { add = 70 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader < 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 50 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 2 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 20 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader = 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage < 3 } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { OR = { check_variable = { cwddr_leader > 3 } check_variable = { cwddr_wende_stage > 2 } } } }
				modifier = { add = 10 DDR = { check_variable = { cwddr_sed_control > 70 } } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 0 } }
				modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 1 } }
				modifier = { add = 20 check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 > 2 } }
				modifier = { add = 25 check_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_5 = 3 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_last_pos = cwgg_u_pos } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_last_dpos = cwgg_u_dpos } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_last_ch = cwgg_u_cur } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos > 0 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = cwgg_u_dpos } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = cwgg_u_pos } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = cwgg_u_pos } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = cwgg_u_pos } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = cwgg_u_pos } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = cwgg_u_pos } } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = 3 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_last_ok = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 91 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	else = {
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_fail = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_1 = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_2 = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_3 = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_4 = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_shift_5 = 1 } } }
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -2 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_last_ok = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 92 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_dpos = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } } }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.20 days = 1 }
	if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.21 days = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_fail > 7 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 93 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_collapse = yes
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 0 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_initial = yes }
	else = {
		if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.31 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.32 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.33 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.34 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.35 days = 1 } } }
		}
	}
}

# All five chapters agreed: the treaty is initialled and goes to the Four Powers.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_initial = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 3 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 1 } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.41 days = 3 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 2 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 1 } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.42 days = 3 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 2 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 1 } } ENG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.43 days = 3 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 2 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 1 } } FRA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.44 days = 3 } } }
	else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 2 } } }
	set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 94 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
	every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDIP.250 days = 1 } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_powers_check = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_powers_check = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 3 } NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cwgg_u_outright }
			clr_country_flag = cwgg_u_outright
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 95 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_collapse = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 3 } check_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 3 } } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_veto = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_veto > 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 96 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
				COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_collapse = yes
			}
			else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_1 = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_1 = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_2 = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_2 = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_3 = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_3 = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_4 = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_4 = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_5 = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_reopen_5 = 0 } } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 2 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_m = 0 } }
				hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 2 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 4 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 5 } } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 0 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_cur = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 0 } } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_sov = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_usa = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_eng = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_fp_fra = 0 } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.45 days = 1 }
				if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.45 days = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 97 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwgg_t_log = 98 }
COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_log = yes
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.50 days = 2 }
			if = { limit = { DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.51 days = 2 } } }
			else = { set_country_flag = cwgg_u_rat_ddr }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_ratify_check = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 4 } has_country_flag = cwgg_u_rat_brd has_country_flag = cwgg_u_rat_ddr }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_execute = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_collapse = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 0 } }
	set_country_flag = { flag = cwgg_unity_cd days = 1095 value = 1 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_detente_m = 0 } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_klima = -15 } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = cwgg_klima min = -100 max = 100 } }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.60 days = 1 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { is_ai = no } } DDR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGU.60 days = 1 } } }
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
}

# The united Germany, as negotiated (GER scope).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_execute = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 5 } }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_by_detente
	every_other_country = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GDIP.260 days = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_socialist_unity = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 = 2 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art146 = yes }
		else = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_art23 = yes }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_by_treaty
		# the alliance
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 2 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_neutralise = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 = 3 } }
			COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_neutralise = yes
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_faction_leader = yes } } SOV = { add_to_faction = GER } }
		}
		# the economy
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_mixed_economy }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 = 3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_planned_economy }
		# the capital
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 > 1 } 45 = { is_owned_by = ROOT } }
			set_capital = { state = 45 }
			if = { limit = { 45 = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GER_1970_sdm_capital_berlin } } } } 45 = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GER_1970_sdm_capital_berlin } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 = 3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_centralised_state }
		# the borders
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 1 } } if = { limit = { country_exists = POL } POL = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = large_decrease } } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_border_reserved }
		else = { if = { limit = { country_exists = POL } POL = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = large_increase } } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 = 3 } } if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = medium_increase } } } }
	}
}


COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_count_agreed = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_1 > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_2 > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_3 > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_4 > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_ch_5 > 0 } } hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_u_agreed = 1 } } }
}


# Neutrality: out of every bloc (GER scope).
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_neutralise = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = NATO_member } NATO_leave = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_neutral_germany
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 }
		mdcw_cw_change_alignment = yes
	}
}

# A socialist Germany built on the GDR (GER scope): East Berlin takes over the Federal Republic.
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_socialist_unity = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_socialist
	every_state = { limit = { is_core_of = GER } add_core_of = DDR }
	DDR = {
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GER_1970_idea_socialist_unity

	}
}
